items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: Yeah, I think he taught Bonnie Begard.

ctx.x: It was before your time, right? That was before my time, yeah. And had I, well, I don't remember when did he die, but I don't believe he was dead yet, you know, when I was trying to get somebody to teach me if I could do anything about him. Probably I'd have been able to get him.
Because Papa, Teo was a teacher quite a bit. Yeah, he had a lot of scholars. He taught some of those, Albert Nicholas too.
Yeah, I think he taught Bonnie Begard.
